subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw support `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a stable plugin-runtime API for exact-profile, credential-derived quota reads before the related multi-profile usage work builds on it?
rationale: This is a new SDK-facing auth/provider capability, not a repair to an established public contract; code review can assess safety, but maintainers must decide whether this is a supported extension boundary and accept its compatibility obligation.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Accept the exact-profile read as a supported plugin-runtime contract, contingent on redacted real-provider proof and the documented no-refresh/no-fallback guarantees.

options.title: Keep the seam internal for now
options.body: Do not expose the SDK method until the multi-profile usage product direction and supported plugin consumers are agreed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Accept the exact-profile read as a supported plugin-runtime contract, contingent on redacted real-provider proof and the documented no-refresh/no-fallback guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author has the most direct implementation context; a repository owner should make the final product-contract decision.
